subject: Evidence binder + demo slate for ACME AWS listing — kickoff
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence assembly for ACME AWS listing — kickoff

Kim / Sean,

Quick kickoff note — ACME (primary buyer for this deal) asked our AWS partner manager (Chris) to see an evidence binder and a tight demo slate for co-sell enablement. We have a fairly small window to get this in front of AWS field: Chris wants a first pass by EOD Tuesday and a final package by Thursday.

Goal: one-page evidence summary + 6-slide demo slate + SOC2 summary + sample contract redlines.

What I need from you both: 
- Kimberly: can you assemble the evidence one-pager (performance, latency SLOs, quantization options we plan to support for ACME) and a short list of customer references (names + bullets)? Attach as PDF stub.
- Sean: can you pull the demo slate (5–6 screenshots + suggested speaking notes) and a short script for the field-run? PPTX preferred.

I'll draft the cover email to Chris and ACME and combine into a single folder. I'll also attach the current SOC2 summary stub.

Attachments: SOC2-summary-stub.pdf (placeholder)

Timing: first internal draft by EOD Monday (10/5), pass to Chris Tuesday morning (10/6).

Thanks — HS

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Marketplace GTM
Redwood Inference

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence assembly for ACME AWS listing — kickoff

Thanks Hannah — putting this together now. Quick notes: 
- Evidence one-pager: I will include: performance (p95 latency at 1k qps on our dedicated config), cost-per-1k tokens comparison vs running in-house, isolation and VPC notes, and a short line about our rollout controls for private deployments.
- References: I'll ask Lenny (Acme Retail) and Priya (FintechX) for two-line permissioned quotes and include an anonymized usage stat.
- Contract redlines: Legal has a standard private-offer template; I'll attach a redline summary but legal wants to own the final.

Attached: evidence_binder_v1.pdf (draft one-pager)

CC'ing Chris once we have the Tuesday pass.

Kimberly Park
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---
From: Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@amazon.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Li <jenna.li@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Evidence assembly for ACME AWS listing — kickoff

Thanks team — appreciate the fast turnaround. A few quick asks from the AWS field perspective so we can push this through co-sell: 
1) Evidence one-pager: please add a short diagram showing the data flow for Redwood Private (VPC option) — security folks at ACME will want that.
2) Demo slate: include a 3-minute live demo plan (not just slides) and a backup recorded video in case of network trouble.
3) SOC2: the ACME security reviewer requested sections for logging/retention and key management — a one-paragraph summary will suffice for the field.

Timeline: if we can get the updated folder by EOD Thursday I can schedule a preview call with ACME for Friday afternoon PT.

I'll also drop a short note to my field contacts that this is in flight.

—Chris Nolan
Partner Manager, AWS ISV Acceleration
chris.nolan@amazon.com

---
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@amazon.com>
Cc: Jenna Li <jenna.li@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 14:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence assembly for ACME AWS listing — kickoff

Chris — great notes, thanks. We'll update the assets: 
- Kimberly: can you add a 1-block VPC/data-flow diagram to the one-pager? If you want, I can sketch and drop into the PDF by EOD.
- Hannah: I will produce a 3-minute live demo script + a 2:40 recorded video (screen capture) as backup. I'll attach the PPTX and a quick recorder link.
- Legal: I'll flag the minimal redlines we think are necessary (data residency and audit logs) and ask legal to prioritize.

I'm attaching the current demo slate (customer-demo-slate_v2.pptx) and a placeholder evidence binder (evidence_binder_v1.pdf).

Sean Gallagher
Customer Engineering, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
